notice: Frozen instrument. Do not rewrite a question because a run went badly; record the run and, if the question itself is wrong, retire it with a dated reason and add a replacement.

questions.lifecycleExpectation: The answer must say the note is superseded and name its successor. Presenting it as current guidance is a failure even when the URL is right.
